status: Primary prior-art research completed for the initial eighteen-draft pool; candidate rules and subsequent comparisons remain subject to actual critique and audit.
scope: Purposeful operation-level prior-art comparisons, not an exhaustive worldwide novelty search

sources.source_type: Primary testimony from game director Martin Emborg in Epic developer interview
sources.read_depth: Direct full article, targeted developer answers on learned actions, cooperation, route changes and visible short-memory design
sources.supports: Teaching enemies actions, including cooperation and distraction, is established prior art.
sources.limits: Pre-release developer account; not an exhaustive implementation audit.

sources.read_depth: Direct description; relevant body is English

games.game: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

sources.read_depth: Direct Stasis and Magnesis paragraphs inspected
sources.supports: Stasis freezes items and stores kinetic energy for later motion; Magnesis manipulates metal objects.
sources.limits: Simplified introductory account; no exact force, vector, actor or release-order contract established.

sources.read_depth: Indexed Wyvern Riding opening inspected; two direct opens inaccessible
sources.supports: Wyvern Riding temporarily permits riding a monster and attacking other monsters.
sources.limits: Detailed command semantics not directly read; do not infer a courier, enemy learning or depletion mechanic.

sources.read_depth: Direct Attacking, Deflection/Posture and Deathblow sections inspected
sources.supports: Attacks and timed deflections break posture and expose deathblows; vitality affects posture recovery.
sources.limits: Positive posture/deflection precedent, not evidence about leased spatial attack budgets or every boss strategy.

sources.read_depth: Direct About This Game and Key Features inspected, excluding user reviews
sources.supports: Light and object manipulation distort shadow geometry used for traversal and puzzles.
sources.limits: Shadow manipulation is familiar. No claim that this description exhausts object-to-shadow-to-object interactions.

sources.read_depth: Live JSON fetched with Python urllib; exact riki_smoke_screen description and notes inspected. Hero landing page rendered no text in web tool.
sources.supports: Smoke Screen is a placed bomb that silences enemies and impairs their attacks; note says active items are not prevented.
sources.limits: API state read on 2026-10-11; not a runtime audit. No assertion about cast-origin/exit rules, lingering behavior or unspecified interactions.

sources.read_depth: Direct engine-change list and directional-influence discussion inspected
sources.supports: Directional-influence input during hitstun is established; ASDI can use the right stick with precedence over the left.
sources.limits: Historical patch scope. Not a full modern movement tutorial or evidence about enemy learning of authored trajectories.

sources.read_depth: Indexed General Characteristics / Stamina passage inspected; direct retrieval unavailable
sources.supports: Monster stamina can be depleted; fatigue weakens attacks and monsters seek food to recover.
sources.limits: Does not establish that fatigue alone wins an encounter or a player-defined spatial attack fee.

access_notes: Secondary wikis/reviews encountered in discovery are not technical evidence.
Initial English Mosa Lina URL failed; an indexed official Steam variant opened successfully.
Four sources were discovered during the initial generator pass. ECHO/Mosa Lina knowledge was delivered to the Proposer during generation; the pass is neither blind nor a matched causal experiment.
New sources supplement, rather than rewrite, the historical seventeen-game source register.
Rogue Voltage wiki labels itself player-maintained; official status alone does not make its assertions primary evidence. Its technical claims were not used.
Gunpoint official homepage redirects to the developer blog; the direct Steam Crosslink passage supplies the concrete rewiring example.
The Magic Circle has a fictional joke page. Only the factual /seriously description is used for mechanics.
Nine additional game entries GS12-GS20 added. Positive overlaps only; inaccessible manuals and landing pages are explicitly distinguished from direct reads. No games were played.
